limitations: BLOCKED: the 24 numbered runs 051122_Sample_{1,2,3,7-12,16-21,25-30,34-36}.raw cannot be mapped to treatment (regorafenib vs control), labelling scheme (singly labeled vs duplex core/outer) or SILAC channel occupancy from public evidence; the mapping is in the paper's Supplementary Materials (Supp. Fig. 8 / Supp. Fig. 3, NIHMS1942467-supplement-Supp_Materials_1/2.docx), which could not be retrieved (Europe PMC: not open access; PMC/ACS behind bot challenge). These runs are omitted from the SDRF.

Heavy1-3 / Light1-3: whether these are 2D monolayer label-incorporation controls or singly labeled spheroids, and their treatment, is not stated per file; characteristics[treatment] is 'not available' and no factor value is declared.
Raw files were not opened beyond the header (techsdrf not run); instrument/settings come from the paper and mqpar.
characteristics[biological replicate] 1-3 is taken from the Heavy/Light file-name suffix; Heavy n and Light n are separate cultures, not pairs (they differ in comment[label] and source name).
